backgroundDisclosure.title: Location during your shift
backgroundDisclosure.body: PROSM Time collects your location about every 5 minutes to confirm that you are at your work site, even when the app is closed or not in use, but only while you are clocked in. It stops when you clock out. Your location is shared with your organisation's managers and deleted after 30 days. On the next screen, choose "While using the app" for this to work.

deleteAccount.whatGoes: Your account will be deleted for good: you cannot sign in with it again, and your personal data goes - your name, email and picture, your clock-in and clock-out photos, your location trail, leave documents, devices and notifications.
deleteAccount.whatStays: Your organisation keeps the work records the law and payroll require (attendance, timesheets, leave, allowances) under "Deleted user".
deleteAccount.clockedIn: Clock out first, then delete your account.

deleteAccount.ownerBody: Yours is the owner's account, and the whole organisation and its data hang on it. To delete it with the organisation, or to hand ownership to someone else, write to us and we will take care of it.

startupPermissions.title: PROSM Time permissions
startupPermissions.intro: The app needs three permissions to work fully. This is what each one is used for:

location.title: Location
location.body: Used to confirm that you are at your work site when you clock in and out. At sites where your organisation has turned on presence monitoring, and only while you are clocked in, PROSM Time collects your location about every 5 minutes, even when the app is closed or not in use, with an ongoing notification the whole time, and stops when you clock out. Your location is shared with your organisation's managers and deleted after 30 days.

camera.title: Camera
camera.body: To take a photo when you clock in or out, only at sites that require one. The camera opens only when you take the photo yourself.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.body: For answers to your leave requests and approvals, clock-in and clock-out reminders, urgent alerts, and the shift notification while you are clocked in.

startupPermissions.footer: After "Continue", Android asks for each permission in turn: choose "Allow" or "While using the app". You can change any permission later in the phone's settings.
